invocation.command:
ls bugs.md 2>&1; python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, re
root = "src"
pat = re.compile(r'\.(unwrap|expect)\(|panic!|unimplemented!|todo!|unreachable!|unsafe\s*\{|transmute|catch_unwind|mem::forget|ManuallyDrop|ptr::|ffi::')
for dp, dn, fns in os.walk(root):
    for f in sorted(fns):
        if not f.endswith(".rs"): continue
        p = os.path.join(dp, f)
        lines = open(p, errors="replace").read().splitlines()
        # find test module start lines
        teststarts = set()
        for i, l in enumerate(lines):
            if re.search(r'#\[cfg\(test\)\]|mod tests?\s*\{', l): teststarts.add(i)
        for i, l in enumerate(lines):
            s = l.strip()
            if s.startswith("//"): continue
            m = pat.search(l)
            if m:
                intest = any(t < i and (i - t) < 4000 for t in teststarts)  # rough
                print(f"{p}:{i+1}:{'TEST?' if intest else 'PROD?'}:{s[:150]}")
EOF
